data.desc: Noodles & Company has known noodles since 1995. For more than 30 years, the brand has brought people together over craveable classics and globally inspired flavors, from indulgent Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese to bold Japanese Pan Noodles. With more than 390 company-owned and franchise restaurants, Noodles is built on craveable flavors, fresh ingredients and bringing people together over great food. The brand partners with experienced franchise operators who share its commitment to delivering great food and exceptional guest experiences. Recognized by Newsweek as one of America's Favorite Restaurants and Best Loyalty Programs and honored by Forbes and QSR as a top employer, Noodles continues to define what it means to be a fast-casual favorite.
